latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of keyapi-tiktok-ecommerce — comprehensive TikTok Shop market intelligence tools.

- Analyze products, shops, and categories on TikTok Shop using GMV, sales trends, reviews, and more.
- Access detailed analytics nodes: product, shop, and category performance, creator attribution, and live-stream commerce.
- Step-by-step workflow to resolve category and product IDs, filter analytics, and interpret results.
- Requires KEYAPI_TOKEN and Node.js; easy setup via npm.
- Includes detailed usage scenarios and command examples for all supported data queries.
